title: CORE-7113 · SHARED: body inline links don't underline on hover
body:
**Linear:** [CORE-7113](https://linear.app/bsq-group/issue/CORE-7113)

## Verified 2026-08-24 — reproduces

Body rich-text inline links underline on hover on live; on the clone they do not. Measured
with a real mouse hover on the SAME two links on the SAME page, identical selector:

| Link (`/id-requirements`) | Live | Clone |
|---|---|---|
| "Privacy Policy" | none → **underline** | none → none |
| "Terms and Conditions" | none → **underline** | none → none |

Root cause: `src/blocks/TextContent/TextContent.styles.ts` `richTextShell.links` explicitly
set `[&_a:hover]:!no-underline` — the clone was actively suppressing the underline.

## Scope boundary — accordion answers must NOT change

The FAQ/accordion answer rich text (`src/blocks/FAQs/FAQs.styles.ts`, via the shared
`Collapsible`) has its own `[&_a]:no-underline` with no hover rule. That is CORRECT:
live's accordion-answer link ("London Service Address" on
`/director-appointment-resignation/`) also does **not** underline on hover (rest=none,
hover=none, verified headed on live).

So "SHARED" here means the body rich-text shell only. Changing `FAQs.styles.ts` too would
introduce a divergence from live, not fix one.
acceptanceCriteria: Body rich-text inline links underline on hover on the clone, matching live (rest `none` → hover `underline`).
Resting state is unchanged — no underline at rest, link colour unchanged.
FAQ/accordion answer links are NOT changed: they stay without a hover underline, matching live.
Verified with a real mouse hover at 360 and 1800 on at least two pages.
